problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -5\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix above. Find its decomposition using Jordan blocks.
worked_solution:
Our matrix can be represented as the composition of two Jordan blocks (one $3\times 3$ block and one $1\times 1$ block), as follows:

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -5\end{aligned}]={J}_{3}(1)\,⊕\,{J}_{1}(-5)
$$
